title: ActionPlan
description: Result of action.preview, action.get (adds operation), action.decline and action.undo (m4-actions §3; m9-ai-powers §3.1 adds group, what, flags, resources; §4 adds kind fix, title, why and steps; §5 adds kind script and script). Approval binds planId + planHash + a single-use nonce (a script's also binds the dialog's options).

actionId.description: null on a fix plan (its steps name their actions).

label.description: The handler's label, e.g. Change power plan; null on a fix plan.

title.description: m9 §4: a fix's title (AI text, sanitised, display only); null on single plans and undo fixes.

steps.description: m9 §4: a fix's steps in execution order (n); null on single plans; [] on a fix that is too_large.

leftOut.description: m9 §17.1: on an AI's fix only, the steps left out because they need administrator rights (admin_not_allowed: switched off under Permissions; admin_unavailable: not in this version), in the AI's order. Handler text only, display only, never executed; covered by planHash. Absent when nothing was left out.

cardId.description: m9 §17.3: the card an AI plan belongs to (a fix ask's card, or a cardRef); null otherwise. Absent on plans stored before m9 §17.3.

attemptId.description: m9 §17.3: the fix attempt the plan belongs to (with cardId).

narrowedFrom.description: m9 §17.3 action.narrow: the plan this one replaced, with the steps the user kept (a reduced plan: its verified run does not close the card). Covered by planHash.

removed.description: m9 §17.3 action.narrow: the steps the user switched off, by label, in their order. Covered by planHash; kept in the receipt.

replacedBy.description: m9 §17.3: on a parent cancelled by action.narrow (ineligible.code replaced), the plan that replaced it.

target.description: A manual.open plan (kind manual): {type: settings, id: the Settings page URI, label: the finding title, settingsPath?: the page as Windows names it in English, design v59, only on English Windows}. Design v60: a finding with no Settings page but with guide lines (steps done elsewhere, e.g. the BIOS) gets {type: manual, id: the finding ID, label: the finding title} (no settingsPath; resources [manual:<findingId>]; rows []); a finding with neither is refused (-32013 no_settings).

group.description: m9 §3.1: the handler's catalog group (optional for plans stored before m9).

what.description: m9 §3.1: one plain sentence saying what the action does.

flags.description: m9 §3.1: consequence flags, handler's plus the resolution's (a fix: the union of its steps'); covered by planHash.

resources.description: m9 §3.1: canonical resource keys the plan locks at approval (a fix: the union; [] when ineligible); covered by planHash.

nothingToUndo.description: Design v62: true when the action changes nothing that would need undoing (a Defender scan or definitions update, a file check or image repair, clearing the DNS cache, restarting Explorer, making a restore point); then supported is false. Never true on an irreversible or data_loss plan or step. Omitted otherwise.

kind.description: codex: legacy, read only (plans stored before M9 dropped the Codex provider; never produced now).

targetRef.description: m9 §3.1: the evidence a targetRef named (the handler resolved target from its local fields); null or absent otherwise.

status.description: A script plan (m9 §5.7) follows its operation's end state: completed, failed, stopped, timed_out, not_run or indeterminate; never verified.

script.description: m9 §5.2/§5.7: a script plan's script; null when the script was refused (ineligible).

settingsPath.description: Design v59: the page as Windows names it in English (e.g. Settings › Apps › Startup), sent beside manualUri only when Windows’ display language is English and the page has a known path; absent otherwise.

steps.description: m9 §4.1: a fix's blocked steps; [] for too_large and stale_plan.

then.description: m9 §5.7: always irreversible and runs_code, never undoable, no steps, no resources (the run takes an exclusive lease instead).
A manual.open plan names the finding's Settings page (design v59) or, design v60, no page (a finding with guide lines only: the steps are done elsewhere, e.g. the BIOS).

script.description: m9 §5.2/§5.7. text is the approved text (CRLF, no BOM); sha256 is lowercase hex over the UTF-8 BOM + CRLF bytes that run; bytes counts the BOM. parts are the AI's explanations, quoted and not checked. guard.warnings are visible lines on the card. bypassesPolicy: the run adds -ExecutionPolicy Bypass for that one process.

why.description: m9 §4: the AI's reason, shown as a quote with its author; never decides what runs.

step.description: m9 §4 manifest step. An ineligible step keeps its n, action, label and privilege; target/before/after are null and the lists empty.

nothingToUndo.description: Design v62: true when the action changes nothing that would need undoing (a Defender scan or definitions update, a file check or image repair, clearing the DNS cache, restarting Explorer, making a restore point); then supported is false. Never true on an irreversible or data_loss plan or step. Omitted otherwise.
